name: Casino Sotho
description: Sotho Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Lesotho. Similar to Swazi Casino with face-up capture piles and the ability for opponents to use top cards in builds. Features numerical values for picture cards and complex building mechanics.

overview.description: Sotho Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in Lesotho. Similar to Swazi Casino with face-up capture piles and the ability for opponents to use top cards in builds. Features numerical values for picture cards and complex building mechanics.

history.origins: Sotho Casino is the Lesotho variant of the African Casino family, closely related to Swazi Casino (Eswatini) and South African Casino. It was documented by Jonathan Dushoff. The game shares the characteristic African Casino feature of face-up capture piles.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in Lesotho
Current: Part of the Southern African Casino family
history.cultural: Played in Lesotho and surrounding areas. The game is part of the broader Southern African card game tradition. Lesotho is a mountainous kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa.
history.evolution: Sotho Casino follows the same evolutionary path as other African Casino variants, diverging from Anglo-American Casino by keeping captures face-up and allowing opponents to use the top card of capture piles in builds.

setup.players: 2-4 players. 4 players play in fixed partnerships (partners opposite). Play is anticlockwise.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face value, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1 or 14.
setup.dealing: Similar to Swazi Casino: cut 4 cards for initial layout, deal all cards to players. Some variations in dealing rules exist between regions.

rules.objective: Capture cards from the layout. First player/team to reach target score wins.
rules.gameplay: Core rules same as Swazi Casino: Captured cards kept face up in pile. Top card can be used by opponents in augmented builds. Must play exactly one card per turn. Can perform multiple build actions. Single builds (sum=value) and augmented builds (multiple sets with same value). Build owner must eventually capture. Drifting (using capturable card in build) allowed. Cannot capture directly from opponent's pile.
keyRules: Picture cards: J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14
Opponents can use top card of your pile
Must play one card per turn

strategy.basic: Same as Swazi Casino: Capture when beneficial, build when you have the card, be careful about early captures.
strategy.intermediate: Focus on high-value builds (13s, 14s). Time captures to minimize opponent access to valuable top cards.
strategy.advanced: Complex build warfare. Creating build monopolies. Using opponent's capture pile against them. Partner signaling in partnership games.
tips: Build monopolies on aces (14) or kings (13)
Watch what you leave on top of your pile
